rationale: Make new frame event-file creation tolerate the observed intermittent Windows PermissionError by routing write_event_file_atomic through the existing bounded replace_with_retry helper, while preserving atomic replacement, explicit failure after retry exhaustion, and the current deployed Skill boundary.
rollback_triggers: partial or invalid frame event file produced
existing frame file changed after retry exhaustion
frame or ledger regression suite failure
deployed Skill modified without a separate adoption and deployment authorization
